definitions.short: a rill (i.e. small channel of water, as in irrigation)
definitions.full: H6388. peleg I. מֶּ֫לֶג noun masculine Psa 65:10 (cleft) channel , (artificial) canal ; — usually plural מְּלָנִים Isa 30:25 ( + יִבְלֵימָֿ֑יִם ); construct מַּלְגֵימַֿיִם Psa 1:3 , simile Isa 32:2 ; Prov 21:1 , metaphor 5:16 , of tears Lam 3:48 ; Psa 119:136 ; מְּלָגָיו 46:5 (i.e. irrigating canals from river, metaphor); מַּלְגֵישָֿׁ֑מֶן Job 29:6 (figurative of prosperity); singular אֱלֹהִים מֶּלֶג Psa 65:10 , poetic of channel for rain (compare Job 38:25 ).
